Jack Heart, 2026-11-13: "Okay I agree. This is probably something that should start as soon as we're done with 56". Reason: EXP-56 moves the launcher database to schema 16, and its QA found the branch CLI refuses a launcher.db written by main, so releasing it without a migration path interrupts running Manabot work.
